captions.detailed: A compact, portable box fan with a square, off-white housing and a fold-flat carry handle bridging the top edge. The inner blue fan blade assembly is mounted on a central black motor hub and spins continuously on its axis. A circular front protective grille is attached via side-edge hinges, allowing it to swing open, while a black control knob on the right face of the housing rotates continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a portable box fan with a square housing, a top carry handle, a front protective grille, a central motor with a blue multi-blade fan, and a side control knob. Ensure the fan blades, carry handle, front grille, and control knob are modeled as separate parts with appropriate rotational joints.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by subtracting a large cylinder from a box primitive to create the central air tunnel, adding corner reinforcements, and placing a small back motor support. Model the fan assembly using a central hub cylinder with extruded, angled rectangular blades. Create the front grille using concentric rings and radial spokes, mounted on a side hinge rod. Construct the top handle by sweeping a circular profile along an arc path, and model the side control knob as a small cylinder with radial ridges.
